```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Read in gene matrices from 10X output using Seurat package.
# Multiple samples were were captured from each patient (FH = femoral head, FN = femoral neck)
# Each sample was digested with either the Garvan method using collagenase A + dispase, or the Relation method using collagenase IV + dispase.
# Patient 22 and 24 CD45neg ALPL_low and ALPL_high and ALPL_neg cells were captured
# Patient 22 and 24 normal and diseased region (osteoarthritis) of femoral head were captured
# Patient 26 cortical bone was included in the processing of femoral neck samples
# Combine, QC, assign clusters, find markers and save object.
# Note: due to the amount of data, analysis was run on a High Performance Computer (HPC)

#Load libraries
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(plyr)

# Load the raw dataset for Patient_011_FH_G
Patient_011_FH_G.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Patient_011_FH_G <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Patient_011_FH_G.data, min.cells = 1, min.features = 100)
Patient_011_FH_G <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_G, metadata="Patient_011", col.name="Patient")
Patient_011_FH_G <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_G, metadata="Female", col.name="Gender")
Patient_011_FH_G <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_G, metadata="FH", col.name="Site")
Patient_011_FH_G <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_G, metadata="Garvan", col.name="Digestion")
Patient_011_FH_G <- RenameCells(object = Patient_011_FH_G, add.cell.id = "Patient_011_FH_G")

# Load the raw dataset for Patient_011_FH_R
Patient_011_FH_R.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")
Patient_011_FH_R <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = Patient_011_FH_R.data, min.cells = 1, min.features = 100)
Patient_011_FH_R <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_R, metadata="Patient_011", col.name="Patient")
Patient_011_FH_R <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_R, metadata="Female", col.name="Gender")
Patient_011_FH_R <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_R, metadata="FH", col.name="Site")
Patient_011_FH_R <- AddMetaData(Patient_011_FH_R, metadata="Relation", col.name="Digestion")
Patient_011_FH_R <- RenameCells(object = Patient_011_FH_R, add.cell.id = "Patient_011_FH_R")

Patient_032_FN_G_cort.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")

# Load the raw dataset for Patient_034_FN_G OA
Patient_034_FN_G.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "file_location")

#Merge 
Patient_034_merged <- merge(Patient_034_FN_G, y = c(Patient_034_FN_G_cort))

#Merge data of all patients
RRx_OA_merged <- merge(RRx_011_merged, y = c(RRx_012_merged, RRx_014_merged, RRx_020_merged, RRx_022_merged, RRx_024_merged, RRx_026_merged,  RRx_030_merged, RRx_032_merged, RRx_034_merged))

# Mitochondria Genes and number of genes QC
RRx_OA_merged[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(RRx_OA_merged, pattern = "^MT-")

pdf("plots/nFeature_QC.pdf", width = 15, height = 7.5)
VlnPlot(RRx_OA_merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), pt.size = 0.01, y.max = NULL, split.by = "Patient") 
dev.off()

pdf("plots/percent_mito_QC.pdf", width = 15, height = 7.5)
VlnPlot(RRx_OA_merged, features = c("percent.mt"), pt.size = 0.01, y.max = NULL, split.by = "Patient") 
dev.off()

#Filter 
RRx_OA_merged <- subset(RRx_OA_merged, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200)
RRx_OA_merged <- subset(RRx_OA_merged, subset = percent.mt < 10)

#Normalise data
RRx_OA_merged <- NormalizeData(RRx_OA_merged, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

#Find variable features
RRx_OA_merged <- FindVariableFeatures(RRx_OA_merged, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

#Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(RRx_OA_merged)
RRx_OA_merged <- ScaleData(RRx_OA_merged, features = all.genes)

#Linear dimensional reduction
RRx_OA_merged <- RunPCA(RRx_OA_merged, features = VariableFeatures(object = RRx_OA_merged))

#Clustering
RRx_OA_merged <- FindNeighbors(RRx_OA_merged, dims = 1:20)

#Resolution multiple
RRx_OA_merged <- FindClusters(RRx_OA_merged, resolution = 0.5)

RRx_OA_merged <- RunUMAP(RRx_OA_merged, dims = 1:20)

#FindAllMarkers
Idents(RRx_OA_merged) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.5"
markers_0.5 <- FindAllMarkers(RRx_OA_merged, only.pos = T)
markers_0.5 <- markers_0.5[markers_0.5$p_val_adj < 0.05,]

write.csv(markers_0.5, file = "RRx_OA_merged_markers_res0-5_adj_pval.csv")

#save post UMAP object
save(RRx_OA_merged, file = paste0(output, "RRx_011_to_034_OA_only_complete_merged_post_UMAP_20250303.Robj"))

#diet
RRx_OA_merged_diet <- DietSeurat(RRx_OA_merged, dimreducs = c('pca','umap'))

#save diet
save(RRx_OA_merged_diet, file = paste0(output, "RRx_011_to_034_OA_only_complete_merged_post_UMAP_diet_20250303.Robj"))
```
